title: Pre-Train Mini-GPT
motto: GPT-2 Small has 124 million parameters. That's 12 transformer layers, 12 attention heads, and 768-dimensional embeddings. You can train it from scratch on a single GPU in a few hours. Most people never do this. They use pre-trained checkpoints. But if you don't train one yourself, you don't actually understand what's happening inside the model you're building products on.

steps.title: Why this matters
cards: You know what a transformer is. You have read the diagrams. You can recite "attention is all you need" and draw boxes labeled "Multi-Head Attention" on a whiteboard.
None of that means you understand what happens when a model generates text.
